eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; Arizona; at 9:07 PM on AUG 20, 2026 Effective until 5:07 AM AUG 21, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A SAFE Alert has been issued on behalf of the Mesa Police Department. The Mesa Police Department is looking for Silvio Batres who was last seen on August 20, 2026, at 1pm in the area of South Val Vista Drive and Main Street, Mesa, AZ.  He left his residence on foot and due to a diagnosed medical condition, Silvio becomes lost easily and is not familiar with the area.  Silvio is described as a Hispanic male, 43 years old, 6 feet tall and weighing 190 pounds.  He has black hair and brown eyes.  Silvio was last seen wearing a faded green shirt and navy blue shorts and does not have a cell phone. If located please call 911 or contact the Mesa Police Department. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
